Class PopupFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.PopupFactory
public class PopupFactory extends Object
Builds the transient popups shown over the game screen: card detail, the per-character-type card list, and the hover-driven invention (tools) panel.

Stateless aside from its GuiNodeFactory collaborator — popups are created on demand and auto-hide.

    • setupInventionPopup

      public void setupInventionPopup(javafx.scene.image.ImageView anchor, Supplier<Set<String>> ownedTools)
      Wires the hover-driven invention popup to the HUD anchor. On mouse-enter the panel is refreshed from ownedTools (owned tools are highlighted, the rest greyed out) and shown; on mouse-exit it hides.
      Parameters:
      anchor - the HUD icon that triggers the popup on hover
      ownedTools - supplies the set of owned tool names at hover time
